info.name: Agent tool-call authorization matrix (Phase 9)
info.description: The AGENT-TOOL-AUTHZ slice proven end to end through the gateway, with the collection itself as a deterministic scripted MCP client (streamable HTTP, POST /mcp: `initialize` answers plain application/json and assigns Mcp-Session-Id as a response header; `notifications/initialized` answers 202 with an empty body; every later request is SSE-framed). Cells E1–E11 of docs/to-do/implemented/AGENT-TOOL-AUTHZ/10-QA-TEST-CASES.md. Every assertion is on the actual cut — which tool names, which denials, which LAYER — never on response shape alone. E6 (PDP kill), E7 (agent-gate off) and E11 (revocation) are drills the runner orchestrates around the rig: run this collection with scripts/postman/run-agent-tool-matrix.sh, not standalone.

exec: // Both halves matter: a revocation that only cleared the roster would still let a
// client that remembered turn 1's list call the tool.
